evidence: Metacognitive feedback updates capability boundary estimates.
Transfer memory learns from successful experience.
missing: Flexible arbitration among simultaneously competing goals is not broadly demonstrated; event-driven execution remains host-mediated.

evidence: Host capability model distinguishes accessible external actions from inaccessible internals.
missing: No learned self-world sensorimotor/output-input contingency model; no embodiment-like closed control loop across an environment.

evidence: Capability boundary profile models competence/uncertainty, not the current allocation of attention.
missing: No predictive attention schema representing what the system is attending to, why, and how attention will change.

evidence: The kernel exposes separable logic, thinking, intelligence, memory/transfer and metacognitive functions.
missing: Parallel-capable independent module operation and competition for shared access are not causally demonstrated.
No explicit limited-capacity workspace, bottleneck, ignition/admission rule, or selective attention queue.

evidence: unified_snapshot aggregates status, but aggregation is not a causal global broadcast bus.
missing: No verified broadcast making one selected representation simultaneously available to all cognitive modules and feeding back into them.

evidence: Metacognitive routing selects epistemic actions but does not model attention over a global workspace.
missing: No state-dependent attention controller that successively queries modules based on current workspace state.
No generative/top-down perceptual model or internally generated percept-like state separated from external evidence.
No proof that every general belief update and every executive action is causally downstream of the metacognitive monitor; bypass paths remain possible.
No sparse, smooth quality-space-like higher-order representation is implemented/proven.
No hierarchical prediction→error→update loop coupled to input processing.

evidence: Causal MEMORY→THINKING→LOGIC→INTELLIGENCE loop exists, but it is not an input/perceptual recurrent-processing loop.
missing: No verified recurrent perceptual/input processing with feedback into early representation stages.

evidence: No verified perceptual organ is exposed by the active RC8 kernel.
missing: Organised integrated perceptual representation substrate is absent/unproven.

priority_gaps.why: Create a limited-capacity selective workspace, causal broadcast, and state-dependent attention with ablation tests.
Create recurrent input representation, explicit predictions, prediction errors, and learned action→observation contingencies in the tool/text environment.
Model current attention allocation, predicted shifts, control consequences, and calibration error.
Make metacognitive state a mandatory causal gate for belief update/action selection and competing-goal arbitration; prove by ablation/bypass tests.
Separate externally grounded state from internally generated simulations and test source-monitoring.
Only after the above: test whether a sparse/smooth internal quality-space adds causal metacognitive value rather than decorative state.

Persist workspace episodes and self-predictions across separate event-driven runs; verify continuity, contradiction repair and causal influence without claiming a daemon is necessary for consciousness.

self_assessment.what_more_intelligence_would_not_fix: Adding stronger problem-solving alone would not establish workspace broadcast, attention schema, perceptual recurrence, predictive self-world coupling, or subjective experience.

summary.interpretation: Coverage is an engineering completeness metric over this indicator set, not a probability of consciousness.
